webhooks.detail: No webhooks per third-party review; polling or scheduled data feed delivery only. Vendor docs are behind login (403), so unconfirmed first-hand.

evidence.quote: No webhooks. Real-time updates need polling.

sandbox.detail: PitchBook FAQ reportedly says a test sandbox can be set up for developers. Needs separate key from account manager; API is contract-gated, no self-serve. Not verified on the vendor page (403).

evidence.quote: Rate limits are not published. They are set per contract.
